$meta.name: CLEANPLATE Design Tokens
$meta.description: Single source of truth. Consumed by the Tailwind config (frontend + site) and the Tauri desktop theme. Do not hand-edit generated outputs — edit this file and run `node design/generate.mjs`.

brand.name: CLEANPLATE
brand.tagline: Remove it. Rebuild it. Ship it.
brand.sub: Eight restoration tools, one queue, running on your own machine.

mask.note: Plate Cyan at 35% with a 1px solid edge. Never red — red reads as error, and users stare at masks for hours.

font.sans: Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
font.mono: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'JetBrains Mono', 'Fira Code', Menlo, Consolas, monospace
font.monoUse: All numbers, resolutions, timecodes, file sizes, progress percentages render in mono.

space.note: 4px base unit. All spacing is a multiple of 4.

motion.note: No bounce, no spring, nothing playful.
